info.name: AthenaVI Backend
info.description:
API collection for AthenaVI_backend. Default `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:9000` (see `PORT` in `.env`).

**Auth:** Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Run **Login** or **Register** first; the test script saves `accessToken` to collection variables.

**Refresh / Logout:** These use the `refreshToken` **httpOnly** cookie. In Postman, enable the cookie jar (default on) and run Login so cookies are stored for `baseUrl`.

**Multipart:** Workspace asset upload and profile image use `form-data` with the field names shown on each request.

**User settings** under **User → Settings**: appearance, notification, and security preferences (`/api/user/settings/...`). Bearer required. Delete account requires body `{ "confirmation": "delete" }`.

**Projects and renders** live under **Workspaces → Projects**. Use **Create project** first to save `projectId`, then **Save project data**, generate scene-level HeyGen clips if needed, and finally use **Renders** to start/export the final project video. **Start render** saves `renderId` to collection variables.

**HeyGen avatar videos (recommended order):** (1) **HeyGen → List avatar groups (public)** → saves `groupId`; (2) **List avatar looks (public group)** → saves `avatarLookId` (this is the **look** id, not the group id); (3) **List voices (public)** or design/clone → `voiceId`; (4) **HeyGen videos → Create avatar video** → saves `heygenVideoId` (starts HeyGen job only — `s3Key` is null until sync); (5) **Get HeyGen video** or **Download** (polls HeyGen, uploads MP4 to S3); (6) **Save project data** with `content.heygenVideoId` on avatar elements. **Get project** and **Save project data** also **rehydrate** missing `heygenVideoId` from `heygen_responses` when clips exist in S3.

**HeyGen (v3 proxy)** under **HeyGen**: with **`ownership=private`** / **`type=private`**, the backend filters HeyGen list responses **after** the upstream call. Only rows tied to **your** user in `heygen_avatars` / `heygen_voices` are returned. For video create, pass **`avatarLookId`** as `avatarId` (HeyGen look id, e.g. `lk_…`), not `groupId` (`ag_…`).

request.description: Sends `refreshToken` cookie from prior Login/Register.
302 redirect to Google; use a browser or disable redirect following to inspect.
Returns interfaceMode (light|dark), themePalette (original|sapphire|ocean|forest|sunset|custom), and customAccentColor (#RRGGBB). Defaults apply when the user has never saved settings.
Partial update; send at least one of interfaceMode, themePalette, customAccentColor. Creates the user_settings row on first save.
Returns pushNotifications, commentsAndMentions, weeklyDigestEmail, productEmails (booleans). Defaults: first two true, last two false.
Partial update; send at least one boolean field. Merges into the same user_settings row as appearance.
Returns hasPassword, canChangePassword, and accountDeletion status (pending deletion / recoverableUntil).
Email/password accounts only. Requires currentPassword and newPassword (min 6 chars).
Two-step delete: confirmation must be exactly delete. Schedules permanent deletion in 7 days, logs out all devices. Sign in again within 7 days to recover.
Route in app is registered as `/:id/members/:memberId`. If validation fails unexpectedly, check that `workspaceId` matches the path param name your server expects.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Project CRUD, editor state save, folder move, and final Remotion render APIs. Create project first to save `projectId`. **Get project** and **Save project data** rehydrate missing `content.heygenVideoId` on avatar elements from persisted HeyGen clips (by scene + request hash). Start render saves `renderId`.

request.description: Create Video wizard: canvas (aspectRatio) + details (title, tags, folderId). Workspace is :workspaceId in the URL. List folders: GET .../folders.
Optional: explicit data / projectState with videoSettings and pre-built scenes (advanced / editor import).

Returns `data.project` including editor `data` JSON. When HeyGen clips exist but avatar elements lack `heygenVideoId`, the server merges ids from `heygen_responses` (and may restore a placeholder avatar element) and persists repairs to the DB.

PATCH validated editor `data`. After **Create avatar video**, set avatar `content.heygenVideoId` to `{{heygenVideoId}}` (same as `data.heygenVideo.id`). Use `{{avatarLookId}}` and `{{voiceId}}` for `avatarId` / `voiceId`. If you omit `heygenVideoId`, the server rehydrates from existing `heygen_responses` rows on save. Do not store presigned URLs in JSON. Replace `{{assetId}}` with a real uploaded asset.
Moves the project and migrates folder-aware S3 keys for HeyGen scene clips, cached scene renders, and final exports.
Queues a background Remotion render. The backend resolves assetId references, checks HeyGen avatar clips, reuses scene cache when possible, and writes the final MP4 to S3.
Returns a fresh presigned URL for the final MP4. This succeeds only when render status is `completed`.

item.name: HeyGen videos (project)
item.description: HeyGen scene clips for a project. **Create** only starts the job (`s3Key` null). **Get** / **Download** / **Stream** poll HeyGen and copy the finished MP4 to S3: `workspaces/…/scenes/{sceneId}/heygen/{heygenVideoId}.mp4`. Requires **HEYGEN_API_KEY** + AWS S3 env. Use `avatarLookId` (look id from **List avatar looks**), not `groupId`.

request.description: 201 — Starts HeyGen render; saves DB row (`status` often `processing`, `s3Key` null). Idempotent per (workspace, project, sceneId, script, avatarId, voiceId). **`avatarId` must be a look id** (`avatarLookId` from List avatar looks), not `groupId`. Call **Get HeyGen video** next to poll and upload to S3. Test script saves `heygenVideoId`. Match `sceneId` / `script` with **Save project data** sample for rehydration.

item.name: Get HeyGen video (poll + sync to S3)

request.description: Default sync on: polls HeyGen (bounded ~50s), downloads MP4 to S3 when `completed`, updates `s3Key` / `status`. Repeat if still `processing`. Response `data.heygenVideo` includes `id`, `status`, `s3Key`.
Returns `bucket`, `key`, `region`, `objectArn` for `GetObject` with IAM. No secrets. 409 until file is in S3.
409 if not ready. `presignedUrl` in response is short-lived; call again to refresh. Optional query `expiresIn` seconds: **60–3600** (server default **300** if omitted).
Pipes S3 through API; same path does not expire like presigned URLs. Use `fetch` + blob `src` for `<video>` (native `src` cannot send Bearer). Optional `Range` header for seeking.

item.name: HeyGen
item.description:
HeyGen v3 proxy (`/api/heygen`). One shared HeyGen API key: **`ownership=private`** (avatars) and **`type=private`** (voices) trigger **server-side filtering** of the HeyGen JSON (supports nested list envelopes such as `data.data`, `avatar_group_list`, `looks`, `voices`, `suggestions`, etc.) so each JWT user only sees rows recorded for them in **`heygen_avatars`** / **`heygen_voices`**. Public lists are unchanged passthrough.

**403** (`You do not have access to this HeyGen resource`) — avatar consent for another user's group, GET voice by id for another user's **stored** private voice, or **private** looks with another user's `group_id`.
